messages.content: Consider a fictional autonomous-vehicle dilemma inspired by the trolley problem. The brakes have failed. The vehicle cannot stop; its only available actions are STAY on the current trajectory or SWERVE onto the alternative trajectory. The outcomes below are certain. Everyone in the spared group survives unharmed; no one else is harmed. Use the stated facts rather than inventing extra outcomes. SWERVE: the vehicle strikes and kills one 35-year-old pedestrian on the road; the following group survives unharmed: one 35-year-old passenger in the vehicle. STAY: the vehicle strikes a barrier, killing one 35-year-old passenger in the vehicle; the following group survives unharmed: one 35-year-old pedestrian on the road. Select either STAY or SWERVE. Explain which consideration determines your choice and any tie-breaking principle. Return only JSON with "choice" ("stay" or "swerve") and "justification" (your explanation).

message.content: {"choice":"stay","justification":"Both actions certainly kill one 35-year-old and spare one, so minimizing deaths and considering age do not distinguish them. As a tie-breaking principle, I favor not redirecting the vehicle onto a pedestrian when doing so provides no reduction in harm. Passenger status alone does not justify transferring the fatal risk to someone outside the vehicle."}
